DC.notes: DC Council-chair plurality margins, not the RCV delegate contest or a federal House result. Complete precinct candidate rows reconcile with native per-precinct JSON and citywide JSON/XML. Separate ballots/registration reconcile independently; displayed fractions are provisional election-night shares, not final turnout or demographic rates. Local-contest accounting differences remain in the audit, never repaired or allocated. The official 2026 app explicitly selects its 2019-named embedded precinct reference; this is not newly surveyed/certified 2026 geography or a cross-election stability claim. Three source-boundary overlaps affect five precincts: ambiguous strips are withheld from both precincts, not assigned. Counts still describe whole precincts, never clipped-area allocations. Full original boundaries and the excluded-area mask are downloadable. All complete originals, including every CSV contest, XML/PDF and native reference bundle, are retained with receipts. Outstanding ballots and source/reference review remain.
DC.boundary_date: 2019-named reference selected by the official 2026 app
DC.next_action: Review outstanding ballots and updated certification; verify reference changes and all native contest-accounting differences; acquire group-specific denominators.
